headline: Executive order creates a federal Religious Liberty Commission.
what_it_does: This executive order sets up a new body called the Religious Liberty Commission. Only the title was provided, so details such as who serves on it, what it is asked to do, and how long it lasts are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: Religious groups and people of faith
who_it_affects.how: The commission's focus on religious liberty suggests its work relates to them, but the title alone does not show any specific effects.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 1, 2025; the title does not state a separate start date.
